blocks.text: Quantum theory electromagnetic shuaon ko tawanai ke alag alag packets, aur bohat chhote paimane par zarrat ko lehron jaisa bartao karne wala samajhti hai. Yeh ghaliban physics ki sab se kamyab theory hai jo hal na hone wale masail samjhati aur durust peshgoiyan karti hai. Rozmarra zindagi ke aam amal ke liye classical physics ab bhi durust hai. Yeh chapter quantum theory ke mukhtalif pehlu dekhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Quantum asraat kahan ahem hain, aur classical physics kahan ab bhi achha kaam karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Quantum asraat atom jitni cheezon aur un se amal karti shuaon ke liye ahem hain; rozmarra ke aam, bare paimane ke amal ke liye classical physics achha kaam karti hai.

items: Quantum theory: shuaein packets (quanta) mein; chhote zarrat lehron jaise.
Rozmarra ke amal ke liye classical physics ab bhi durust.
